provenance: Retained real Joern output from the disposable flow-map feature fixture; captured by test/semantic-flow-map.live.test.js. Replayed without a worker.

gaps.detail: Reaching definitions may conservatively couple predicate operands; inspect assignments and assert values at every effect/return
Implicit exceptions, external effects, concurrency and path feasibility are not exhaustively modeled

assumptions.detail: Static control and reaching-definition edges are candidates. They do not prove feasibility, equal values, runtime order, or every-path enforcement.
External calls may change data or throw. Unresolved dispatch, aliasing, reflection, async execution, and implicit exceptions are not exhaustively modeled.
Bodies cover the selected entries and bounded reachable methods in exact retained CPGs. Transport boundaries are shown with their evidence; no distributed execution or field mapping is inferred.
